$comment: Shared sanitizer cases for BOTH implementations of the chat text rules:
Neither suite has hostile cases of its own that the other lacks, so the two sanitizers
cannot drift: a rule changed in one language fails here in both. `expected` is the cleaned
line, or null when the line must be refused, in which case `reason` is the rejection reason
(also the label of flysim's fly_chat_rejected_total{reason} metric).
A string field may instead be { "repeat": { "unit": "a", "count": 5000 } }, which both
loaders expand to `unit` repeated `count` times — long spam cases stay readable.

cases.name: an ordinary chat line survives unchanged
cases.input: go left! the ledge is right there
cases.expected: go left! the ledge is right there

cases.name: leading, trailing and repeated spaces collapse
tabs and newlines become single spaces rather than rejecting the line
non-ASCII letters are allowed
NFC normalization: a combining acute folds into the precomposed letter
NBSP and ideographic space fold to an ordinary space
allowed punctuation passes through
digits and a decimal number are not mistaken for a host name
cases.input: route 1 took 3.14 minutes, e.g. this one
cases.expected: route 1 took 3.14 minutes, e.g. this one

cases.name: a bridge template reply passes (these are posted with bot: true)
cases.input: Sugar from fly_fan_42! The fly gets a brief PAM reward pulse.
cases.expected: Sugar from fly_fan_42! The fly gets a brief PAM reward pulse.

cases.name: exactly the length cap is accepted
one code point over the cap is refused
5000-character spam is refused rather than truncated
a NUL byte is a control character
a bell is a control character
an ANSI escape sequence is a control character
a zero-width space is not a space
a zero-width joiner is refused
a right-to-left override is refused
a left-to-right mark is refused
a byte order mark is refused (it is not White_Space)
combining marks (zalgo) are refused
emoji are refused for now
markup characters are refused
backticks are refused
pipes are refused
a dollar sign is refused (shell-shaped, and no price belongs on screen)
an empty message is refused
whitespace-only is refused
a scheme is a URL
a scheme-relative host is a URL
www. anywhere is a URL
a TLD-like token is a URL
a two-letter TLD is a URL
case does not hide a URL
the URL rule is deliberately over-eager: a dotted word is refused
control characters are checked before the character set
the character set is checked before the length cap
the length cap is checked before the URL rule
typographic punctuation a phone keyboard produces is allowed
a bridge template reply with an em dash passes
cases.input: No hand-written strategy, no lookahead search — just the fly.
cases.expected: No hand-written strategy, no lookahead search — just the fly.

cases.name: CJK stops and brackets are allowed
a mathematical symbol is not punctuation
a currency symbol is refused like the ASCII dollar
